# Official AoS app text import fixtures

Army lists copied out of **Warhammer Age of Sigmar: The App** (Storm Forge), captured verbatim as
the app puts them on the clipboard.

Parser: `src/importers/aos4/officialApp.ts`
Tests: `src/tests/aos4/officialAppFixtures.test.ts` (corpus-wide), `importOfficialApp.test.ts`
(targeted semantics and source-detection rejections)

## Layout

```
official-app/
  lists/<id>/
    list.txt         as pasted, byte-for-byte
    expected.json    golden — the decoded roster, regenerated by yarn fixtures:official-app
```

Naming follows the New Recruit corpus: `<faction-slug>-<nnn>-<shape>`, e.g.
`ij-001-renown-heavy`.

## Adding a list

1. Save the pasted text to `lists/<id>/list.txt`. **Do not tidy it** — the separators, the blank
   lines, and the trailing footer are all load-bearing signals the parser keys off.
2. Run `yarn fixtures:official-app` to write `expected.json`.
3. **Read the golden.** It records whatever the parser does today, so it proves nothing on its
   own. Check every unit in the paste appears, that no scaffolding leaked into a label, and that
   `declaredFaction` is the faction rather than a grand alliance or parent publication.
4. Run `yarn vitest run src/tests/aos4/officialAppFixtures.test.ts`.

Anything the golden cannot express — a rejection, a diagnostic, a specific parse rule worth
naming — belongs as an explicit case in `importOfficialApp.test.ts`.

## What the corpus-wide test checks without the goldens

The goldens catch drift; these catch the parser being wrong in the first place:

- the roster decodes with **no diagnostics** — see "illegal is not malformed" below
- `declaredFaction` is a name the generated catalog actually carries as a `faction`. This is the
  strongest oracle here: it is what fails when header parsing goes wrong, and it would have caught
  a `-----` separator being read as the faction.
- no selection label is scaffolding (`Regiment 2`, `Auxiliary Units`, `Legends`, `Drops:`, a run
  of dashes), is empty, or still carries a points suffix
- every selection traces back to a non-empty line of the source text
- decoding is deterministic and CRLF-insensitive

## Illegal is not malformed

Several fixtures are deliberately over points — `ij-001` is 9060/3000 — and repeat units across
regiments. Whether a list is *legal* is a list builder's and a tournament organiser's concern;
AoS Reminders turns a list into reminders. Illegal armies must import cleanly and never warn.
Fail closed on malformed or hostile input, never on an illegal army.

## Shapes covered

| id | covers |
| --- | --- |
| `ser-001-current-format` | baseline current export: `REGIMENTS`, `FACTION TERRAIN`, `n ×` counts, `• General` |
| `sce-001-exported-version-format` | the older `Exported with App Version:` footer, dashed regiment-of-renown members, rules prose that must not be read as a unit |
| `cos-001-grudgebound-legends` | grand-alliance pipe header, per-unit `• Legends`, multi-manifestation lore line, Freeguild Command Corps bundled sub-units |
| `gg-001-army-of-renown` | two-part pipe header with no grand alliance, `Army of Renown`, numbered regiments, `Auxiliary Units` |
| `om-001-multi-terrain-auxiliaries` | battle formation with a points suffix, **two** faction terrain entries, non-contiguous regiment numbering, older `General's Handbook 2025-26` |
| `ij-001-renown-heavy` | three-part pipe header with a parent publication instead of a grand alliance (`Orruk Warclans \| Ironjawz \| …`), 21 dashless regiments of renown, `Scourge of Aqshy:` names |
| `sob-001-renown-no-terrain` | regiments of renown with no faction terrain section and no spell lore |
| `dok-001-legends-repeats` | the same unit repeated 11 times each with its own `• Legends`, a curly apostrophe in a unit name, faction terrain that carries points |
| `fs-001-older-handbook` | `General's Handbook 2024-25`, two seasons back, and no battle tactics line |
| `idk-001-renown-army-no-lore` | an Army of Renown with no lore, drops or tactics rows at all — header, regiments and terrain only |
| `ko-001-renown-army-repeats` | a two-part Army of Renown header with a `• Legends` mark mid-regiment and repeated units across two regiments |
| `lrl-001-multi-lore` | a spell lore row holding three lores and a manifestation row holding seven, both with points suffixes, plus two identical faction terrain entries |
| `ser-002-model-counts` | `Terradon Riders (2 models) (70)` — a model count and a points cost on one line — plus three identical faction terrain entries |
| `sce-002-renown-army-legends` | 17 `• Legends` marks in one list, mixed straight and curly apostrophes, two pointed faction terrain entries |

## Points are dropped on purpose

The app writes a cost on nearly every line. None of it is kept: reminders come from warscrolls and
abilities, and a points value is roster bookkeeping that only ever gets in the way of matching a
name. The same goes for `Drops:`, `Auxiliaries: n (+20 Points)`, and `Battle Tactics Cards:` —
recorded here in the source text, deliberately ignored by the parser.
